name: simpright-kit
description: The SimpRight Kit's Claude Code plugins, for projects built on the kit.

plugins.name: simpright
plugins.description: Setup and doctor: the setup interview, simpright init and apply at your OK, a first test run, the project's README and CLAUDE.md, the GitHub settings, and a check that explains what's wrong.

plugins.name: simpright-qa
plugins.description: QA agents and skills: analyse a story, write API contracts and test scenarios, automate them, review and heal the tests, record bugs.
